newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: New head at brokerage Lanka Securities.
newsitem.headline: New head at brokerage Lanka Securities.

text.p: Sri Lankan brokerage Lanka Securities said on Friday it was appointing a new head who would take over on Monday.

"Hiran Amarasinghe who is currently group finance manager of Merchant Bank has been appointed as managing director/chief executive of Lanka Securities from Monday," a senior company official told Reuters.
Amarasinghe will continue to function as group finance manager, he said.
Lanka Securities is a Merchant Bank subsidiary. Both firms are subsidiaries of the state-owned Bank of Ceylon.
Amarasinghe replaces Mano Tittawella who takes over on Monday as director general of the Public Enterprise Reform Commission, which oversees privatisations.
